title: Gaussian2 MF
text: Combination of two Gaussian membership functions, 1 input, 1 output; {Standard deviation for left curve sigma1} sets the left Gaussian standard deviation, {Mean for left curve c1} sets the left Gaussian mean, {Standard deviation for right curve sigma2} sets the right Gaussian standard deviation and {Mean for right curve c2} sets the right Gaussian mean. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Standard deviation for left curve sigma1
Standard deviation for right curve sigma2
